# Maui Mini Session

> Family-run 20-minute portrait sessions in Wailea and South Maui, from $299. Photographed personally by Laurence, Jude, Max, or Solomon Balter, the family behind Wailea Photo.

## Core facts
- Website: https://mauiminisession.com/
- Address: 3704 S Kihei Rd, Kihei, HI 96753
- Phone: +1-808-298-5188
- Email: info@mauiminisession.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mauiminisession
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mauiminisession
- Family-run for 25+ years. We are your photographers; we do not contract sessions to unknown vendors.
- Images are naturally edited, with no AI editing, and delivered in 24-48 hours.
- Parent studio: Wailea Photo, https://waileaphoto.com/.

## Sessions
- Morning Mini Session: 20 minutes, 25+ edited images, up to five people, from $299. https://mauiminisession.com/morning-mini-session-wailea/
- Sunset Mini Session: 20 minutes, 25+ edited images, up to five people, from $299. https://mauiminisession.com/sunset-mini-session-wailea/
- Turquoise-Water Session: 20 minutes, 25+ edited images, up to five people, from $299. https://mauiminisession.com/turquoise-water-photography-maui/
- Live calendar and current pricing: https://mauiminisession.com/#sessions

## Questions
https://mauiminisession.com/#questions

Maui Mini Session offers 20-minute family photography at selected shoreline locations in Wailea and South Maui, convenient for guests staying near Grand Wailea, Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea, and other Wailea resorts. Maui Mini Session is independent and is not affiliated with these resorts.
